question: India's first exploration licence auction and AI-Driven Mineral Targeting Hackathon was launched in:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India’s first exploration license auction** and **AI-Driven Mineral Targeting Hackathon** were launched in **Goa**.
 
• The event marked a significant step toward modernizing the **mineral exploration process** in India.
 
• The initiative aims to utilize **artificial intelligence (AI) and data-driven techniques** for efficient mineral targeting and exploration. *Hence, Goa is the correct answer.*
 
• **Goa**, as a state, has been historically significant for its rich mineral deposits, particularly **iron ore**, making it an ideal location for such advancements.
 
• The hackathon and auction are expected to enhance **transparency** and efficiency in the mining sector. *Hence, this initiative was launched in Goa.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Mineral Exploration in India:**

 
 
• **Mineral exploration** is a critical process for discovering and harnessing natural resources. It involves identifying potential sites for mining and evaluating their economic viability.
 
• India is rich in **mineral resources**, including **coal, iron ore, bauxite, and limestone**. The mining industry contributes significantly to the economy.
 
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence in Mineral Exploration:**
 
 
• **AI-driven techniques** enable the analysis of large datasets to identify potential mineral-rich areas. These methods are faster and more accurate than traditional exploration techniques.
 
• **Machine learning algorithms** can predict locations with high mineral potential by analyzing geological, geophysical, and geochemical data.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Goa:**
 
 
• **Goa** is known for its abundant deposits of **iron ore**. The state has been a hub for mining activities for decades.
 
• The launch of the exploration license auction and hackathon in Goa highlights its importance in the **mining and mineral exploration sector**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Benefits of AI in Mineral Exploration:**

 
 
• **Efficiency:** AI reduces the time and cost required for mineral exploration by analyzing data swiftly and accurately.
 
• **Accuracy:** Machine learning models can identify mineral-rich areas with higher precision, minimizing errors.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives in Mining Sector:**
 
 
• **National Mineral Policy:** The government has introduced policies to promote sustainable mining and exploration practices.
 
• **Exploration License Auctions:** These auctions aim to provide transparency in the allocation of mining rights and attract private investment.
